Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver one eight-keyframe sheet of the SAME ELF CUSTOMER from image1.
Image1 (elf-3x.png) is the authoritative APPROVED identity, face, costume, proportions and exact coarse pixel style. Image2 (anatomy-guide.png) is ONLY an anatomical pixel-grid guide and comparison, no lines/labels should appear in output.
Preserve this elf's short chestnut-brown side-parted hair with a long fringe on SCREEN RIGHT, small sage-green leaf hair clip on SCREEN LEFT, TWO clearly pointed ears, wide cute head, pale face, simple sage/lime-green short tunic with fitted small waist, short green sleeves, pale warm hands and inner blouse area, exposed short knees, dark plum boots. Gentle youthful elf with the same androgynous/feminine impression as the approved sprite. NO hat, cape, long skirt, long robe, trousers, backpack, belt ornaments, elaborate jewelry, staff, magic or weapon. Do not redesign her as the traveler, male keeper or mage. The standing hem is NARROW and tidy:10 pixels at waist,12 pixels at lower hem, never a wide flaring skirt. Preserve green garment color-block distribution and leaf clip.
TRUE low-resolution logical32x48 frame for EVERY pose, on actual transparent alpha. No hat: top11 rows remain EMPTY. Head including hair/face/ears fits a22x16 reference frame in rows11..26 (actual approved head occupies x5..25). Face chin aboutrow25 and bottom head outline on26. Do not grow the head to fill the unused hat space. Torso/garment rows27..39,13 pixels high. Actual thighs/knees/short boots rows40..46,7 pixels high; skin knees on40..41 and short dark boots to baseline46 in standing poses; row47 transparent. Walking lifted knees may bend slightly above40 but body/head size and hip remain the same. Two eyes are each ONE pixel wide TWO tall at native x10/x15,y21/22, equal height, with a FULL1skin-pixel gap around each including diagonals. No pupil touching hair, no3-pixel eye blob, no eyebrows/lashes or eye shadow. Nose on SCREEN LEFT, face is a LEFT-facing three-quarter view while BOTH eyes stay visible.
Use EXACTLY FIVE colors: outline/eyes/boots deep plum-black #241C32; pale warm face/hands/knees/inner blouse #F6D1AC; single chestnut hair shade #916047; sage green outfit/leaf clip shadow #718C59; light lime green outfit accents #B5C77D. No extra white, yellow/gold, orange, brown shade, green shade or blush. One native pixel continuous outline, simple big color blocks, absolutely no gradients, antialiasing, dithering, tiny texture or dense folds.
Layout exactly4equal columns by2equal rows. Same character size and head alignment in all8cells. Generous transparent gaps between figures. No figure crosses any cell boundary. Author EACH complete coherent whole-body pose; no torso/leg fragments attached from another pose and no whole-figure mirroring to fake alternate phases. Face/hair/leaf clip stay oriented to LEFT in every cell.
Poses left-to-right top row then bottom:
0 IDLE: same posture as approved reference, feet planted, empty hands relaxed in front.
1 WALK CONTACT A: near leg forward SCREEN LEFT, far leg back SCREEN RIGHT; near arm back/far arm forward, opposite arm swing; slim tunic hem follows the hips.
2 WALK PASS A: near leg supports weight under pelvis, far knee/foot passes lifted1-2pixels; small coherent opposite arm swing.
3 WALK CONTACT B: FAR leg is forward SCREEN LEFT, NEAR knee/foot is behind SCREEN RIGHT; near arm forward/far arm back. Clearly opposite leg anatomy from1, not merely recolor same boots. Keep face/hair direction unchanged.
4 WALK PASS B: far leg supports pelvis, near knee passes lifted; genuine opposite phase of2.
5 RECEIVE EXTEND: feet planted, near empty palm reaches SCREEN LEFT to approximately[5,31] in the logical frame; sleeve and shoulders follow naturally. No potion drawn in hands.
6 RECEIVE HOLD: feet planted, both empty hands gather at front around[12,34], leaving room for a separate bottle above/between palms. No bottle baked into character.
7 BLINK IDLE: identical idle silhouette/head/body/hands/feet to0, only equal eyes closed as two2x1 lines.
The output is a production pixel-sprite candidate sheet, not an illustration. Preserve EXACT existing elf feeling and cute head-to-body balance. Fully transparent background, no grid/floor/shadow/text/numbers/labels, no extra characters or potions.
